thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected on prod-rt pool (us-west-2). Metric: decode_p99=8200ms (SLO 2500ms). Streaming stalls and timeouts reported. Auto-scaler triggered. /incident create #prod-latency 1759876543
sre-oncall: seeing same on dashboards. p95 ~ 1200ms but p99 is huge. Correlates with new runtime build rolled 17m ago.
devon: rolling record: last deployment was runtime v2.14.3 with compiler flag change to enable LTO and -O3 as part of trt/kernels perf patch. I'm pulling deploy notes.
maria: any customer-facing impact? Are streaming clients seeing disconnects?
lia: yes, support thread shows an increase in streaming stalls and partial responses for several customers in EU/US. One big customer reported callback timeout spikes and fallback to sync path.
ops-jen: paging page: @oncall please respond — several alerts from synthetic streaming tests.
sre-oncall: attaching quick logs:
```
2026-06-01T14:22:11Z decode: token_loop 1 latency=8203ms pool=prod-rt kernel=kernel_v7_ldo
2026-06-01T14:22:12Z mem: alloc failure? reclaimed 0 pages
```
devon: I see kernel_v7_ldo introduced along with compile flags: `-flto -fuse-linker-plugin -fno-math-errno -march=znver3` in the build that landed ~18m ago.
tim: could be link-time optimization causing codegen changes that bork allocator paths or flashattn calls. Also TRT upgrade to 8.2 in this build.
maria: traffic graph: p99 spike is regional; us-west-2 & eu-west-1 most affected. us-east-1 looks fine.
lia: reproducer: on staging using the same binary with high concurrency we see streaming tail stalls and KV cache thrash. Stack shows kernel memcpy hot in decode loop.
ops-jen: customers impacted list: acct-omega (partial streams), partners-beta (timeouts), mobile-sdk-corp (increased error rate). Raising CS priority.
sre-oncall: immediate mitigation proposals:
- rollback last runtime build (safest)
- hotpatch compile flag: rebuild with -fno-lto
- enable fallback to smaller decoder model for streaming clients
Which is fastest?
devon: rollback is fastest if we can revert the last deploy, but that requires safe rollout across Dedicated pools. Hotpatch compile requires full rebuild and redeploy — ~30-45m.
tim: we can flip a runtime feature flag to route streaming traffic to legacy kernel binary on the same instances — we have a binary toggling mechanism. That avoids redeploy but needs careful routing rules.
lia: I can flip routing for prod-rt pool to legacy-kernel for streaming-only route. That should restore tails within ~2-5 minutes and avoid total rollback.
maria: do it. Also notify CS and add a banner to status page.
ops-jen: proceeding with routing flip. @devon watch logs for regressions.
(2m later)
ops-jen: routing flip applied. Immediate p99 drop seen to ~2400ms. Streaming stalls subsiding.
devon: logs show legacy-kernel handling new requests; KV cache warmup causing short-term higher p95 but p99 improved. Will start a staged rollback of kernel_v7_ldo on a canary subset to validate.
lia: starting incident timeline notes and customer impact doc now.
maria: CS sent communications to impacted customers with ETA ~1 hour for full mitigation.
ops-jen: next steps, assign owners: devon to root-cause, tim to verify TRT/kernel interactions, lia to coordinate rollback plan, sre-oncall to monitor SLOs and update incident channel. I'll run postmortem template after stabilization.
sre-oncall: handing off to night-shift oncall @devon. If anything regresses escalate to eng-sre.
devon: ack. Investigating memory allocator differences under -flto. Initial hypothesis: LTO inlines certain memcpy paths leading to unexpected register pressure and fallback to slower memcpy leading to stalls under high-concurrency streaming. Also checking third-party TRT calls that might be miscompiled.
lia: capture: core dumps from kernel_v7_ldo attached to internal bug 4582. cc @tim @devon
maria: updating status page and marking incident priority P1 until p99 under SLO for 30m.
ops-jen: tagging incident for follow-up: remediation action=route-to-legacy-kernel, mitigation_time=1759876625, impacted_customers=[acct-omega, partners-beta, mobile-sdk-corp]
(devon): adding repro steps and perf traces to the ticket. Will attempt local build with `-fno-lto -O2` to confirm.
```
# local build
CFLAGS="-O2 -fno-lto -fno-omit-frame-pointer"
make -j12 runtime
```
maria: good catch. Thanks team. Will keep the channel updated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 restored to 2100ms after routing flip. Incident remains open for RCA. incident_id=INC-2026-317
sre-oncall: last check, p99=2100ms, p95=1100ms. Continuing to monitor.
devon: will prepare a rollback or hotfix tomorrow morning after deeper verification. Handing over now.
ops-jen: handoff complete. Night oncall: @devon (primary), @tim (backup). Keep incident channel live. :white_check_mark:
